info.name: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
info.description: Apache Log4j2 contains a JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters that do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.
info.remediation: Upgrade Apache Log4j2 to version 2.15.0 or later. As an interim measure, set the JVM property -Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true.

info.name: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 - Path Traversal and RCE
info.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 contains a flaw in the fix for CVE-2021-41773. An attacker could use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the directories configured by Alias-like directives.
info.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later.

info.name: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
info.description: Cross-site scripting (XSS) is a type of security vulnerability that can be found in web applications. XSS attacks enable attackers to inject client-side scripts into web pages viewed by other users.
info.remediation: Implement input validation and output encoding. Use Content-Security-Policy headers.

info.name: Server Version Disclosure
info.description: The web server reveals its version number in the HTTP response header, which can help attackers identify specific vulnerabilities.
info.remediation: Configure the web server to suppress version information in HTTP headers.
